foreseeable_sequence_of_events: Low signal or model miss; no alert; user assumes no fall
cause: Coverage gap; low recall; unvalidated conditions
control_measure: Development-only use; explicit no-alert caveat; quality abstention; fallback workflow; prospective sensitivity monitoring
verification_method: Clinical safety and prospective event review

foreseeable_sequence_of_events: Hard negative or interference is classified as fall; alert is escalated
cause: Poor PPV; unrealistic prevalence; threshold error
control_measure: Alert budget; hard-negative tests; event-level PPV; acknowledgement and review workflow
verification_method: False alerts per resident-day and human-factors tests

foreseeable_sequence_of_events: Dashboard omits limitations; user relies on absence of recent alert
control_measure: Never display safe status; persistent limitation and coverage status; clinician training

foreseeable_sequence_of_events: Repeated induced fall without approved screening spotter or stop rules
control_measure: Pause staged falls; institutional determination; screened trained adult; mats; spotter; supervisor; stop rules; incident response
verification_method: Protocol and session safety checklist audit

foreseeable_sequence_of_events: Software enables TX without exact approval or suitable antenna
hazardous_situation: People or services are exposed to non-compliant emission
harm: Interference; exposure; regulatory breach; invalid evidence
cause: Broad band check used as approval
control_measure: TX disabled by default; signed profile; approval expiry; antenna EIRP duty-cycle location interlocks; emergency stop
verification_method: Negative start tests and signed RF review

foreseeable_sequence_of_events: RF-derived movement is collected beyond the approved purpose or zone
harm: Loss of privacy; dignity; autonomy; discrimination
control_measure: PIA; purpose limitation; coded IDs; zone opt-out; pause/status; retention; RBAC; audit

foreseeable_sequence_of_events: Unauthenticated client reaches HTTP or WebSocket data
hazardous_situation: Derived or clinical data is disclosed
control_measure: Loopback-only development binding; TLS; authentication; scopes; origin policy; session revocation
verification_method: HTTP and WebSocket access matrix tests

foreseeable_sequence_of_events: Sensor or context is linked to incorrect resident
hazardous_situation: Output is reviewed for the wrong person
control_measure: Coded linkage; explicit room/device binding; confidence/unknown; audit; human confirmation

foreseeable_sequence_of_events: Coverage loss or stale clinical fields are not surfaced
cause: Missing quality gate or freshness metadata
control_measure: Typed health snapshot; freshness; data sufficiency; abstention; stale-field display
verification_method: Stale and no-signal clinical safety tests

foreseeable_sequence_of_events: Model probability is shown without calibration or uncertainty
control_measure: Calibrated probabilities; uncertainty; model version; limitations; no high-confidence wording

foreseeable_sequence_of_events: Prediction triggers treatment or restriction without independent clinical assessment
harm: Inappropriate treatment; loss of autonomy; physical or psychological harm
control_measure: No autonomous treatment; clinician review only; change-control and regulatory review; audit override

foreseeable_sequence_of_events: Partial restart or mutable model path creates inconsistent pipeline
harm: Missed or false event; corrupted evidence; unsafe recovery
cause: No authoritative state immutable registry or bounded shutdown
control_measure: State machine; checksums; service supervision; idempotent workflows; rollback; quality abstention
verification_method: Restart mismatch rollback and shutdown tests
